verdict.rationale: monday's developer docs say the apps framework can create custom board views, item views, dashboard widgets and full-page apps. They also say Vibe, monday's open-source React component library, makes apps 'look native instantly' and 'native from day one', and that actions can be added to item, board and column menus. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the view/widget SDK and design tokens (the evidence is mostly marketing one-liners), and independent or hands-on confirmation that apps built this way actually feel native.
